skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and present key concepts about business and environment.
Master and analyze the interactive relationship between business and environment.
Recognize and master corporate environmental strategies, especially proactive ones.
Understand and analyze corporate approaches to environmental friendliness.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Technical Methods for Improving Environmental Quality
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze technical methods for improving environmental quality from a corporate perspective.
Analyze corporate social responsibility, particularly regarding environmental protection.
Apply knowledge to analyze and discuss corporate environmental strategies and sustainable businesses.
Develop the ability to work in groups by seeking, collecting information, building content, and presenting research results through presentations.
Develop self-study abilities through discussions, questions, and answers on case studies provided in the course.
